messages:
eng-oncall-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: model-serving-503 detected for prod-west-2 cluster. error_rate > 15% over 2m, auto-page to oncall. Pager: @sara-nguyen (primary), @mike-ortega (backup). Please ack and triage.

sara-nguyen: acked. seeing 503s from the inference proxy to runtime. 1 of 3 runtime pods OOMKilled in the last 5m. scaling events in logs. investigating.

mike-ortega: on it. reassigning traffic away from pod-2 via svc drain, will spin up hot-swap instance. leaving a note for ops: possible memory leak in kv-cache eviction path.

chen-wu: adding quick mitigation: roll back last model-serving config push (models.yml v1.12 -> v1.11) and enable prefix-caching=false. rolling now.

eng-oncall-bot: DEPLOYMENT AUTOMATION: rollback job started by @chen-wu -> job id deploy-rollback-2098765432. Estimated 45s.

ashley-p: customer-impact check — internal dashboard shows ~3.2% of requests failing with 503 across hosted API keys. Top affected customers: cust-alpha (0.8% of total errors), cust-gamma (0.6%). No major outage pages from enterprise customers yet. Logging owner @danny to collect affected request_ids for outreach.

danny: collecting request_ids now. running query:```\nSELECT request_id, customer_id, timestamp, route FROM prod_logs
WHERE status = 503 AND ts > now()-10m LIMIT 10000;
```sending sample to #private-customer-notify.

sara-nguyen: mitigation status: rollback completed, new pods healthy, traffic rebalanced, error rate down to 1.4% and trending down. keeping page open for 30m of stability. :thumbsup:

mike-ortega: root cause hypothesis: recent change to kv-cache eviction (PR #4523) changed LRU window and increased memory pressure under certain prompt sizes. We saw a correlated spike at the time of a long-running batch job from internal eval infra.

chen-wu: logs show continuous OOM on pod-2 around 2098765305 -> killed, then recreated with same config. eviction logs attached (pasted below):
```
[2026-04-12T09:21:45Z] kv_cache: evicting key batch-98765 size=1.2GB
[2026-04-12T09:21:46Z] mem: used=31.9GB limit=32GB -> OOM
[2026-04-12T09:21:47Z] kernel: oom_kill process "inference-runtime" pid=4821
```

ashley-p: planning postmortem: propose postmortem drafting session tomorrow 1400 UTC. attendees: eng leads, oncall, product, support, legal if customer notification needed. draft owner: @mike-ortega.

danny: action item for customer impact: gather affected request counts per customer and templated notification draft by EOD. assigning to me.

mike-ortega: I will start the RCA skeleton in the postmortems folder: timeline -> mitigation -> contributing factors -> action items. Will ping for peer review once initial draft complete (aiming 24h).

eng-oncall-bot: NOTE: create_postmortem job scheduled -> pm-2098765432 created, reviewers: sara-nguyen, chen-wu, ashley-p.

ashley-p: legal flagged that any customer-facing language mentioning "OOM" should be cleared with legal. @legal-bot can you queue a quick review of the notification template once @danny posts it?

legal-bot: queued. Please include list of impacted customer IDs and approximate event window. Targeting review turnaround within 3 business hours.

chen-wu: draft technical mitigation actions:
- revert PR #4523 (done)
- add memory headroom alert to runtime (threshold 28GB)
- instrument eviction logs with request_id to trace large-key sources
- add pre-deploy canary that runs long-prompt eval workload for 5 minutes

sara-nguyen: ops/rollout items:
- add automatic fallback to smaller model variant when pod memory > 27GB
- add capacity reserve for eval jobs (dedicated nodepool)

mike-ortega: for RCA timeline: I have the timeline started with root event at 2098765289 (first 503 spike). Will include evidence snippets and logs. Requesting peer review from @sara-nguyen and @chen-wu within 24h.

ashley-p: customer comms: if custodial customers exceed 1% ERR for >30m we notify. currently below threshold after rollback but I'll prepare message templates in #private-customer-notify and hold until legal approves.

danny: tracking action items in the postmortem doc with owners+ETA. quick list now:
- Danny: produce per-customer counts & sample ids (ETA: 5h)
- Chen: add eviction instrumentation + PR to runtime (ETA: 2d)
- Mike: complete RCA draft (ETA: 24h)
- Sara: add alerts & fallback policy (ETA: 3d)
- Ashley: customer notification & legal sync (ETA: EOD + legal review)

sara-nguyen: closing note: will monitor for 60m then move to watch-only. if error rate spikes >3% we reopen paging. thanks everyone for fast mitigation. :coffee:
